exposure: Intra-cesarean insertion of intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD)
Postpartum vaginal insertion of intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD)
cohort: 2094 pregnant women who delivered vaginally or by caesarean section
finding: This study suggests that PPIUCD insertion is a safe and convenient method, but increased population awareness, counseling, and usage are required.
